info.title: card-sharing API
info.description: Errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json (schema: ProblemDetails). Every operation carries `x-policy` (auth kind, role, attestation) from its deny-by-default route policy.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. Never depends on downstream services.
Readiness: the instance can serve traffic (config loaded; DB/Redis checks join here later).

200.description: Ready to serve traffic. Auth: public.

get.summary: My activity. Auth: ses.
get.description:
Every new card, reaction, friend request, accepted request and review hold, also when no
push was sent (AC-31.3). Items the caller may no longer see (unfriended, blocked, deleted,
answered requests) are left out.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: cursor signing not configured.

post.summary: Mark my activity read up to an item. Auth: ses.
post.description:
Never moves backwards. An id that is not one of the caller's items is the same 404 as a
missing one.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: not one of the caller's items.

post.summary:
Register this install's App Attest key. Auth: onb/ses. In log-only mode a failed attestation
still answers 204 (the key is not stored and the failure is recorded).

204.description: Processed (stored when the attestation is valid).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (challenge store down).

post.summary: Issue an attestation challenge. Auth: onb/ses.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (challenge store down).

post.summary:
Sign in with Apple. Auth: none (the ID token is the credential). Creates the account on first
sign-in (status `pending_age`, onboarding session); never links accounts by email (AC-1.3).

200.description: Signed in: an onboarding session for a new or unfinished account, a full session otherwise. Call GET /v1/me for the onboarding step.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: invalid, expired, forged or misaddressed ID token, nonce mismatch, or a replayed nonce.

403.description: ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: the account may not sign in (suspended, banned or deletion pending).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: provider not configured or unreachable, or a fail-closed store is down.

post.summary:
Request an email magic link. Auth: none. Always 202 for a well-formed request, whether or not
the email has an account (no enumeration, AC-1.2); the email is sent asynchronously. The link
works once, for 15 minutes, and only together with this device's PKCE verifier.

202.description: If the address can receive email, a sign-in link is on its way.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (malformed email or challenge, unknown fields).

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: more than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP or for this email (same body either way).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate-limit store down; fails closed).

post.summary:
Sign in with Google. Auth: none (the ID token is the credential). Creates the account on first
sign-in (status `pending_age`, onboarding session); never links accounts by email (AC-1.3), so
the same email as an Apple account is a separate account.

200.description: Signed in: an onboarding session for a new or unfinished account, a full session otherwise. Call GET /v1/me for the onboarding step.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: invalid, expired, forged or misaddressed ID token (including a token for another client id), nonce mismatch, or a replayed nonce.

403.description: ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: the account may not sign in (suspended, banned or deletion pending).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: provider not configured or unreachable, or a fail-closed store is down.

post.summary: Mint a 5-minute re-auth token from a fresh provider proof. Auth: ses.
post.description:
The proof must belong to the caller's own account: a valid proof of another account, an
unknown identity, a forged, expired or replayed token are all 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`. The token
is bound to the calling device session and replaces any earlier one of it.

200.description: Re-auth token for this device session (5 minutes).

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED (bad proof, another account's proof, replayed nonce), SESSION_EXPIRED or SESSION_REVOKED.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (provider not configured or its keys unreachable).

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token. Auth: none (the refresh token in the body is the credential).

200.description: New token pair; the presented refresh token is now used up.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED (unknown token) or SESSION_REVOKED (reused, revoked or ended session: sign in again).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate-limit store down; auth fails closed).

get.summary: Accounts I blocked. Auth: ses.

post.summary: Block someone. Auth: ses.
post.description:
Ends the friendship, drops their pending requests to me, cancels mine to them, and silently
refuses future requests both ways (they get the usual answer; nothing is delivered). The
account must be related to me (friend or a friend request either way), otherwise 404.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no related account with this id.

delete.summary: Unblock someone. Auth: ses. The friendship is not restored.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the caller has not blocked this id.

delete.summary: Cancel an open invitation I sent. Auth: ses.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no open invitation sent by the caller.

post.summary: Accept a board invitation. Auth: ses (+ device attestation).
post.description:
Re-checks in one transaction: the invitation is mine, pending and unexpired; I am still the
owner's friend; no member and I block each other; the collaborator cap holds. Any failure,
and anyone else's invitation id, is the missing 404.

200.description: Joined the board as a collaborator.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no invitation the caller can accept.

post.summary: Decline a board invitation. Auth: ses. Silent to the owner.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no pending invitation of the caller.

get.summary: Boards I own or collaborate on. Auth: ses.

post.summary: Create a board. Auth: ses.
post.description:
The caller becomes its owner (at most 20 live boards, `boards.max_per_owner`). Retrying with
the same `id` returns the existing board with 200 (the id is the idempotency key); an `id`
used by another account, or by one of the caller's deleted boards, is 404.

200.description: Retry of a create: the caller's existing board with this id.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: bad id or title, unknown field.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the id is not available to the caller.

422.description: UNKNOWN_REGISTRY_ID: the backdrop is not a known backdrop.

get.summary: Read one board. Auth: ses. Members only.
get.description:
Each card pin is resolved for the caller on every read: the card (with signed media) only if
it is active and the caller is its owner or a recipient who is still a friend of its owner
with no block either way; otherwise a `private_tile` without any card data; a deleted card's
pin is `removed`. With `since_version`, only pins changed since that board version (tombstones
as `removed`) plus every live card pin come back (`full: false`); without it, or with a
version ahead of the board, a full snapshot (`full: true`). Anyone who is not a member, and
any malformed id, gets the same 404 as a missing or deleted board.

parameters.name: since_version
parameters.description:
The `board.version` of the caller's last sync: only pins changed since then (tombstones
included) plus every live card pin are returned. Omit for a full snapshot.

200.description: The board as the caller sees it.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of which the caller is a member.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: media signing not configured.

delete.summary: Delete one of my boards. Auth: ses. Owner only.
delete.description:
The board disappears for every member at once; open invitations are cancelled. Cards are
never deleted. Collaborators and non-members get the missing 404.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of the caller with this id.

patch.summary: Rename a board or change its backdrop. Auth: ses. Owner only.
patch.description:
Applies only if the board is still at `base_version` (else 409 `BOARD_VERSION_CONFLICT`:
reload and retry). Collaborators and non-members get the missing 404.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: bad title, nothing to change, unknown field.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of the caller with this id.

422.description: UNKNOWN_REGISTRY_ID: the backdrop is not a known backdrop.

post.summary: Duplicate one of my personal boards. Auth: ses. Owner only.
post.description:
Only boards without collaborators can be duplicated. The copy counts against the 20-board cap
and holds my pins whose cards I may still pin, plus decorations. Retrying with the same `id`
returns the copy with 200.

200.description: Retry: the existing copy with this id.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: bad id or title, or the board is shared.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of the caller with this id, or the copy id is taken.

get.summary: Open invitations of my board. Auth: ses. Owner only.

200.description: Open invitations (declined and dropped ones look pending until they expire).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of the caller with this id.

post.summary: Invite a friend to a board. Auth: ses. Owner only. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
post.description:
The invitee must be the owner's current friend (no block) and not a member yet; members plus
open invitations stay within 8. If the invitee and any member block each other, the answer is
the same 201 but nothing reaches the invitee. Invitations expire after 7 days. Re-inviting
after an unanswered invitation waits 7 days after its expiry. A board the caller does not own,
and a target who is not their friend, are the missing 404.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of the caller, or the target is not their friend.

409.description: ALREADY_INVITED (member or open invitation) or COLLABORATOR_LIMIT_REACHED.

get.summary: Members of a board. Auth: ses. Members only.
get.description:
An adult caller who is not friends with a minor member sees that member's display name only
(AC-19.9). Anyone who is not a member gets the same 404 as for a missing board.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of which the caller is a member.

delete.summary: Remove a collaborator (owner) or leave a board (self). Auth: ses.
delete.description:
The member's pins are removed with them and their later writes are refused. The owner cannot
leave their own board (delete it instead). A collaborator removing someone else, a
non-member, and an unknown user get the same 404 as for a missing board.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The member to remove (the caller's own id to leave).

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: the owner cannot leave their own board.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no such member the caller may remove.

post.summary: Apply a batch of pin ops. Auth: ses. Members only.
post.description:
`pin.add` places a card or decoration (at most 100 live pins per board); for a card, the
caller must be able to view it now: a collaborator pins only their own active cards, the owner
also cards they received and can still see (still friends, no block, card active). Anything
else is `NOT_FOUND`; the caller's own held card is `CARD_HELD_FOR_REVIEW`. `pin.update` / `pin.remove` carry the pin
`base_version`: a mismatch is `conflict` with the current pin. Collaborators move and remove
only pins they created (`PIN_NOT_YOURS`); the owner may change any pin. A replayed `op_id`
(or a retried `pin.add` of the caller's own pin) is `applied` again without changing anything.
A board the caller is not a member of is the missing 404.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: no ops, too many ops, duplicate op ids, values out of range, unknown fields.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of which the caller is a member.

422.description: UNKNOWN_REGISTRY_ID: a decoration is not a known decoration.

get.summary: Live public links of a board. Auth: ses. Owner only. Never returns tokens or URLs.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of the caller with this id (collaborators included).

post.summary:
Create a public link to a board. Auth: ses. Owner only, and only at or above the region's
`public_links.min_age` (default 18). Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
post.description:
The response carries the link URL with its 128-bit token once; only a hash is stored, so the
URL cannot be fetched again (a lost URL means: revoke and create a new link).

201.description: Created; `link.url` is shown only now. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key answers the same link without `url` and with `url_already_shown: true` (no second link).

403.description: POLICY_DISALLOWED (owner under public_links.min_age), ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no board of the caller with this id (collaborators included).

post.summary: Create and send a card. Auth: ses + att. `Idempotency-Key` = `client_card_id`.
post.description:
Answers 202 with status `pending_scan`: the card reaches its recipients only after the
known-CSAM hash gate and the nudity classifier pass (it may end `held_review`). Recipients are
the caller's current friends (all, or the requested subset); others are dropped silently and
never named. Replaying the same key or `client_card_id` returns the original 202.

202.description: Accepted; waiting for the content gates.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (unknown fields such as owner_id or status, caption, audience, mask size).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: a media id that is not the caller's (or not of that kind).

get.summary: Read one card. Auth: ses.
get.description:
Visible to its owner, or to a recipient it was delivered to who is still a friend of the
owner, with no block either way, while the card is active (one SQL predicate). Anyone else,
and any malformed id, gets the same 404 as a missing card. Media come as per-viewer signed
URLs (10 min); `original_url` only for the owner; the owner also sees `status` and `hold`.

200.description: The card as the caller may see it.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no card this caller may see.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: media signing not configured.

delete.summary: Delete a card I sent. Auth: ses. Owner only.
delete.description:
Hidden everywhere at once (feeds, widget, card reads answer 404 from the next request); the
media objects are purged right after (unless another of my live cards uses them), so even
outstanding signed URLs stop resolving. Anyone but the owner, a missing card and an already
deleted card get the same 404.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no card of mine with this id.

put.summary: React to a card. Auth: ses.
put.description:
Sets or replaces my one reaction on a card delivered to me that I may still see (same rule as
reading it). The owner cannot react to their own card. Only the owner sees reactions; other
recipients never do. A card I may not see is the same 404 as a missing one.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no card delivered to me with this id.

delete.summary: Remove my reaction. Auth: ses. Same visibility rule as reacting.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no card delivered to me with this id.

get.summary: Reactions on my card. Auth: ses. Owner only: recipients get the same 404 as a missing card.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no card of mine with this id.

get.summary: Limits, feature flags, registry kill switches and the text filter's client hints. Auth: none.
get.description:
Cacheable: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=…` plus a strong `ETag`; a matching
`If-None-Match` answers 304 with no body.

200.description: Public client configuration (cacheable, no user data).

304.description: The `If-None-Match` tag is current; no body.

get.summary:
List the seed users. Development and test servers only (`API_DEV_SIGN_IN=true`); elsewhere
this route does not exist (404). Auth: none.

200.description: Seed users that exist in this database.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the development sign-in is not enabled on this server.

post.summary:
Sign in as a seed user and get a normal session. Development and test servers only
(`API_DEV_SIGN_IN=true`); elsewhere this route does not exist (404). Auth: none.

200.description: Signed in: the same token pair as provider sign-in.

403.description: ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: the seed account is suspended or banned.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: not enabled on this server, not a seed handle, or the seed has not run.

put.summary: Register a push token for this device. Auth: ses.
put.description:
Replaces the device's token of the same kind. A token already registered elsewhere (another
account or device) moves here; the old holder stops receiving. The token only works while the
session that registered it is live (logout, suspension or deletion stop pushes).

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: unknown provider or kind, or a malformed token.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: not the calling session's device.

delete.summary: Remove this device's push tokens. Auth: onb/ses.
delete.description: Idempotent: a device without tokens also answers 204.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: not the calling session's device.

get.summary: Download a ready export once. Auth: none (the single-use token is the capability).
get.description:
The token works once and only until the export expires (24 h after it was ready); a used,
replaced, expired or wrong token, and an unknown id, are the same 404.

404.description: NOT_FOUND for every unusable link.

get.summary: My feed. Auth: ses.
get.description:
Cards delivered to the caller by current friends (no block either way, card active, sender
active), newest delivery first, `limit` <= 30. Unfriending, blocking or deleting removes a
card on the next read. Media are signed for the caller (10 min).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: media signing not configured.

post.summary: Which cached cards to purge. Auth: ses.
post.description:
The app sends the ids it keeps offline on every sync (app start, foreground, feed refresh,
and at least every 30 s while open) and deletes every id in `purge`: cards whose sender was
unfriended or blocked (either way), deleted cards, and cards of suspended or deleted accounts
(AC-6.1, AC-14.1, SR-9). The answer uses the same predicate as a card read, so it is effective
the moment the change commits. An unknown id is purged exactly like a deleted one.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: empty list, more than 100 ids or a malformed id.

get.summary: My pending friend requests. Auth: ses.
get.description:
`incoming`: requests addressed to me that I have not answered; for a minor, a request from an
adult with no mutual friends carries `hint: "adult_no_mutual_friends"`. `outgoing`: requests I
sent that are still open; they all show as pending (declines are silent).

post.summary:
Send a friend request to the owner of an invite or to a handle-search result. Auth: ses + att;
`Idempotency-Key` required.
post.description:
The inviter must accept before a friendship exists. A request between accounts with a block
(either way) gets the same 201 and is never delivered. Repeating a request returns the open
one.

201.description: Sent (or already open). Identical for silently dropped requests.

404.description: NOT_FOUND (unknown invite; foreign, forged or expired search ref) or INVITE_EXPIRED.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED (also: 20 open requests or 30 sent in 24 hours; Retry-After).

delete.summary: Cancel a friend request I sent. Auth: ses.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request id from the outgoing list.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no open request from the caller with this id.

post.summary: Accept a friend request addressed to me. Auth: ses + att.
post.description:
The 20-friend cap is re-checked for both sides at accept time; when either is full the request
stays pending.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request id from the incoming list.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no pending request to the caller with this id.

post.summary: Decline a friend request addressed to me. Auth: ses. Silent: the sender is not told.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request id from the incoming list.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no pending request to the caller with this id.

get.summary: My friends. Auth: ses.

delete.summary: Remove a friend. Auth: ses. Silent: the other person gets no notification (AC-6.2).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the caller has no friend with this id.

get.summary: Preview an invite before adding the inviter. Auth: ses; rate-limited per client IP.
get.description:
Unknown tokens, suspended inviters and blocks (either way) all answer the same 404
`NOT_FOUND`; a reset, expired or used-up invite answers 404 `INVITE_EXPIRED`.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token part of an invite link (22 characters).

200.description: The inviter's display name (no avatar for a minor's invite).

404.description: NOT_FOUND (unknown) or INVITE_EXPIRED (reset, expired or used up).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

get.summary: My account. Auth: onb/ses.

post.summary: Submit the date of birth once. Auth: onb (account in `pending_age` only).
post.description:
Refusal is neutral: 403 `AGE_GATE_REFUSED` with no threshold or region in the body; the
pending account is deleted and the same device / sign-in identity is refused for 24 h.

200.description: Admitted; continue with the profile step.

403.description: AGE_GATE_REFUSED (neutral; account removed), AGE_ALREADY_SUBMITTED (DOB is locked) or FORBIDDEN (not an onboarding session).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (fails closed).

post.summary: Record the OS age signal for the caller's account. Auth: onb/ses.

204.description: Stored; a minor signal applies from the next request.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: OS age-signal ingestion is disabled.

get.summary: Board invitations I received. Auth: ses.
get.description:
Pending, unexpired invitations to live boards: board title, owner name, member count and
expiry. The member list is only visible after accepting.

get.summary: The caller's pending deletion. Auth: ses (also a deletion-pending account's session).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no pending deletion.

post.summary: Request deletion of the caller's account. Auth: re (session + fresh `X-Reauth`).
post.description:
Logs out every device (widget and re-auth tokens included), hides the account's content from
friends, boards and public links at once, deletes the shared boards it owns and removes its
pins from other boards (AC-29.1, AC-29.3; these stay done if the deletion is cancelled).
Requesting again while pending returns the same request.

202.description: Deletion pending; this session is logged out too.

401.description: REAUTH_REQUIRED (missing, wrong or older than 5 minutes), UNAUTHENTICATED, SESSION_EXPIRED or SESSION_REVOKED.

delete.summary:
Cancel the caller's pending deletion within the grace period. Auth: ses (also a
deletion-pending account's session).

204.description: Cancelled: the account is active again.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no pending deletion, or the grace period is over.

post.summary: Request a personal data export. Auth: re (session + fresh `X-Reauth`). One per 24 hours.
post.description:
The ZIP is built 48 hours later (every device is told; `DELETE` cancels until then): one JSON
file per module (account, profile, friends by name, cards, reactions, boards, ...) plus the
account's images as PNG.

429.description: EXPORT_COOLDOWN (one export per 24 h, with Retry-After) or RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: An export's status; when ready, a fresh single-use download path. Auth: re.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no export of the caller with this id.

delete.summary: Cancel an export that is still waiting for its delay. Auth: ses.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no queued export of the caller with this id.

put.summary: Claim or change my handle. Auth: onb/ses (after the age gate).
put.description:
Free to change for 24 h after the first claim; afterwards once per 30 days (both config). A
handle released after the grace window stays reserved for 30 days. Finishing the profile
(display name and handle set) makes the account `active` and the current session a full one.

403.description: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE (age gate not passed) or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

post.summary: Is this handle available to me? Auth: onb/ses (after the age gate).
post.description:
Rate-limited (20/min and 100/day per user, fails closed): it necessarily reveals whether a
handle is taken, and nothing else.

403.description: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE (age gate not passed) or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

get.summary: Get (or create) my invite link. Auth: ses.

200.description: The caller's live invite link (the same until reset; a minor's used-up or expired link is replaced).

post.summary: Reset my invite link: the old link answers "invite expired" from now on. Auth: ses.

get.summary: My notification preferences. Auth: ses.
get.description: Defaults until saved: every type on, quiet hours 22:00-08:00 (applied once `time_zone` is set).

put.summary: Replace my notification preferences. Auth: ses.
put.description:
A type turned off sends no push (the activity tab still shows the event). During quiet hours
alerts are held and sent when the window ends (AC-31.1).

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: bad time, unknown time zone, empty quiet window or unknown field.

put.summary: Set my display name. Auth: onb/ses (after the age gate).
put.description:
The name is sanitized (NFC, invisible and bidi characters removed, whitespace collapsed,
combining marks capped) and checked against the term lists; the stored form is returned.

200.description: Saved; the response carries the stored (sanitized) name.

403.description: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE (age gate not passed) or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

patch.summary: Change my privacy settings. Auth: ses.
patch.description:
Turning "Findable by handle" on needs the region's discovery age (`discovery.min_age`): below
it the answer is 403 `POLICY_DISALLOWED`. Turning it off is always allowed and takes effect on
the next search (the standard "no one found").

403.description: POLICY_DISALLOWED (under the discovery age), ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

post.summary: Mint a widget token. Auth: ses.
post.description:
A read-only token for `GET /v1/widget`, child of the calling session: it is revoked with the
session (logout, log out everywhere, suspension, deletion) and replaces any earlier widget
token of this session. Any other route refuses it with 403.

403.description: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or FORBIDDEN (a widget token).

post.summary: Upload an image into quarantine. Auth: onb/ses.
post.description:
The body is the raw image (`Content-Type: image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/webp` or
`application/octet-stream`), at most 10 MiB, at most 4096 px per side. The format comes from
the magic bytes; a declared image type that disagrees with them is refused. The same bytes of
the same kind return the existing upload (200) instead of a new one (201). The image is
re-encoded and scanned before anyone can see it; this endpoint never returns a URL.

200.description: The same image of this kind was uploaded before.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: bad kind, malformed header or dimensions out of range.

415.description: MEDIA_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: not PNG, JPEG or WebP.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: object storage is down or not configured.

get.summary: Fetch a signed media object. Auth: none (the signature is the capability).
get.description:
Returns the image bytes (`image/webp`) when the signature over the exact key, expiry and viewer
is valid and unexpired; otherwise 403. Clients never build these URLs: they come inside DTOs
(with `expires_at`) and are refetched through the DTO after expiry.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Viewer id the URL was issued to (audit).

403.description: FORBIDDEN: missing, malformed, tampered or expired signature.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the object no longer exists (deleted card).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: signing or storage not configured.

get.summary: State of one of my uploads. Auth: onb/ses. Owner only; never returns a URL.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no upload of mine with this id.

delete.summary:
Revoke a public link. Auth: ses. The link's owner only. Revoking an already revoked or
expired link of the caller is a success too.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no link of the caller with this id.

get.summary: Board snapshot for the public page `/b/<token>`. Auth: svc (web server only).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token part of a public board link (22 characters).

parameters.name: X-Client-IP

get.summary: Invite landing data for `/i/<token>`. Auth: svc (web server only).
get.description:
Unknown, malformed, reset, expired and used-up tokens, and invites whose inviter is suspended,
banned or deleted, all answer the identical 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

parameters.description: The token part of an invite link (22 characters).

parameters.name: X-Client-IP
parameters.description: The visitor's IP address as the web server saw it (keys the per-IP limit).

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (X-Client-IP missing or not an IP address).

404.description: NOT_FOUND for every unusable token.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

get.summary: My active device sessions, most recently used first. Auth: ses.

delete.summary: Log out this device: revokes the current session (and its widget token). Auth: onb/ses.

204.description: Session revoked; its tokens stop working immediately.

post.summary:
Log out everywhere: revokes every session of the account, including this one and all widget
tokens. Auth: ses.

204.description: Every access and refresh token of the account stopped working.

delete.summary:
Revoke one of my device sessions (and its widget token). Auth: ses; the session must be the
caller's own (anything else is 404).

204.description: Revoked; its tokens stop working immediately.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no live session of the caller with this id.

post.summary: Find a friend by exact handle. Auth: ses + att.
post.description:
At most one result, only on an exact case-insensitive match. Accounts under the region's
discovery age, accounts that turned "Findable by handle" off, blocks either way and your own
handle all answer exactly like a handle nobody has (same body, same latency class). Limited
per account (10/min, 30/day), per device and per IP; over a limit the answer is a generic
"try later" (429).

200.description: `{result: null}` or the one account found.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (body shape only; any string is searched).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

get.summary: The widget's card. Auth: wid.
get.description:
The newest card delivered to the caller that they may still see (the feed's predicate),
optionally from one friend. Minimal: id, sender name, a signed `widget_512` image URL and a
deep link; no caption.

parameters.name: friend_id
parameters.description: Only cards from this friend (AC-16.3). Not a current friend = no card.

200.description: The card to show, or null.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: media signing not configured.

actor_id.description: Card sender, reactor or new friend; `null` when the event names nobody.

id.description: Item id; pass the newest one seen to `POST /v1/activity/read`.

subject_id.description:
The card (`card.*`, `reaction.new`), friend request (`friend.request`) or user
(`friend.accepted`) the item is about.

unread_count.description: Unread visible items, counted up to 100.

op_id.description: Client idempotency key of this op.

AgeRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/me/age`. Country hints can only make the policy stricter.

declared_country.description: Country the user says they live in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), if asked.

store_country.description: App store storefront country reported by the OS (a hint, never trusted to loosen rules).

signal.description: `minor` when the OS says the user is under 18, `adult` otherwise.

min_app_version.description: Clients below this version must update (requests get 426 `UPGRADE_REQUIRED`).

reactions.description:
Reaction ids a recipient may send (US-17), in display order; ids in
`kill_switches.reactions` are refused even when listed here.

text_filter.description:
Sanitizer caps and term lists of the shared text filter, for instant hints while typing
(captions, names). The server checks again on submit and its answer is final.

attestation.description:
The `attestKey` object, standard base64 (made with `clientDataHash = SHA-256(challenge
bytes)`).

AppleSignInRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/auth/apple`. The account is derived from the verified token only.

authorization_code.description:
One-time authorization code from the same sheet. The server exchanges it for an Apple
refresh token (kept encrypted, revoked on account deletion). Optional.

oneOf.description: The signing-in device. Recommended: device-scoped limits and cooldowns use it.

id_token.description: Apple identity token (JWS) from the native Sign in with Apple sheet.

nonce.description:
The raw nonce the app generated for this sign-in (16 to 256 visible ASCII characters,
single use). The app passes `lowercase hex SHA-256(nonce)` to Apple; the token's `nonce`
claim must match.

mode.description: `all` (every current friend, the default in the app) or `subset`.

recipient_ids.description:
For `subset`: friend ids (at most the recipient cap, unique). Ids that are not current
friends are dropped silently.

board.description: `board.version` is the cursor for the next `since_version`.

full.description: `true`: a full snapshot (replace every local pin); `false`: a delta to merge.

items.description: Boards the caller owns or collaborates on, most recently changed first.
The owner first, then collaborators by join time.

BoardMemberView.description:
A member as the caller may see them. An adult caller who is not friends with a minor member
gets that member's display name only (no handle).

mine.description: The caller created this pin (collaborators may move/remove only these); absent on `removed`.

version.description: The pin's version (`base_version` for the next update).

BoardView.description: A board's metadata as the caller sees it.

backdrop.description: Normalized registry reference, or `null` for the default backdrop.

version.description: Change cursor: bumped on every change to the board or its pins.

CardMediaView.description: Signed media of a card. URLs live until `expires_at`; refetch the card after that.

original_url.description: Owner only (AC-13.6): never present for anyone else.

CardSenderView.description: The sender of a card as viewers see it.

avatar_url.description: Signed avatar URL once avatars join the media pipeline; `null` for now.

CardView.description: A card as one viewer may see it (card read, feed items).

oneOf.description: Owner only, when the classifier held the card.
`null` while the card is not delivered (the owner's pending or held card).

my_reaction.description:
The caller's own reaction (recipients; the owner sees all reactions via
`GET /v1/cards/{id}/reactions`).

ChallengeResponse.description:
A single-use challenge, valid 5 minutes, for one key attestation or one `X-Attestation`
proof (`clientDataHash = SHA-256(challenge bytes || request hash)`).

ClientLimits.description: Product limits shown by the app. The server enforces its own copies.

backdrop.description: Registry reference `{id, version, params?}` of kind `backdrop`; `null` = the default.

id.description: Client-generated UUIDv7 (lets the app create boards offline).

title.description: 1..=60 grapheme clusters after sanitizing; filtered like every user-written name.

client_card_id.description: Client-generated id; must equal the `Idempotency-Key` header (offline outbox retries).

style.description: `{cut, finish, effects[]}` registry references (validated, unknown ids -> 422).

CreateFriendRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/friend-requests`: exactly one of `invite_token` and `search_ref`.

invite_token.description: Token of the invite the caller opened.

search_ref.description: `ref` of a handle-search result the caller got (10 minutes, caller only).

url.description:
`<share base>/b/<token>`: shown once, never retrievable again. Absent on an idempotent
replay of the same request (`url_already_shown: true`): the server does not keep it.

url_already_shown.description:
`true` on an idempotent replay (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`): the link exists but
its URL was in the first response only. To share it again, revoke it and create a new one.

CreatedPublicLinkView.description: A new link: the only response that carries its URL (and so the raw token).

grace_until.description: Until then signing in again and `DELETE /v1/me/deletion` cancel it; afterwards it is final.

DevSeedUser.description: One seed user the development sign-in can start a session for.

minor.description: Under 18: the app shows the minor experience for this account.

DevSeedUsers.description: The seed users present in this database (`pnpm dev:seed` creates them).

users.description: Empty until the seed has run.

oneOf.description: The signing-in device, as for provider sign-in.

DeviceRequest.description: The device a session is issued to. `id` is a UUID the app generates once per install.

id.description: Client-generated UUIDv7 of the copy (the idempotency key).

code_challenge.description:
PKCE S256 challenge: base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 of a random verifier the app keeps
on this device (43 characters). Verifying the link (T-23) needs that verifier.

ExportView.description: An export as its owner sees it.

available_at.description: Not built before this (48 h after the request); cancellable until then.

download_path.description:
`ready` only: a single-use path (append to the API base URL) to download the ZIP. Every
read issues a new one and invalidates the previous one.

items.description: Most recent friendship first (at most the friend cap, 20).

GoogleSignInRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/auth/google`. The account is derived from the verified token only.

oneOf.description: The signing-in device. Recommended: device-scoped limits and cooldowns use it.

id_token.description: Google ID token (JWS) from the native Google sign-in.

HandleCheckResponse.description: Availability of a handle for the caller. Nothing about any other account is returned.

available.description: `false` when taken, reserved or otherwise not claimable; `true` for the caller's own.

handle.description: `^[a-z0-9._]{3,20}$` after lowercasing (uppercase input is accepted and lowercased).

contains.description:
Blocked when the term appears anywhere inside a folded word (or a spelled-out run of
single letters such as `f.u.c.k`). Use for terms that rarely occur inside innocent words.

words.description: Blocked when the folded text has a whole word equal to the term.

ImageBytes.description: Raw image bytes (request body of the upload).

is_self.description: The caller opened their own invite ("That's you!"); sending a request is refused.

InviteResponse.description: My personal invite link. Share it as a link or QR code.

expires_at.description:
When the link stops working on its own: set only for minors' invites (AC-4.4, region
policy; they also stop after a few uses). `null` = valid until reset.

url.description: `<share host>/i/<token>`; the token is 128 random bits (22 base64url characters).

InviterView.description: The inviter as shown before sending a request.

KillSwitches.description: Registry ids switched off remotely; the app hides them and the server rejects them.

up_to.description: The newest item the user has seen; it and everything older become read.

policy.description:
Region rules that apply to this account (strictest of the signals stored at sign-up and
the current request). The app renders only what these allow.

profile.description: What the caller has set so far (empty fields before the profile step).

MediaView.description: An upload as its owner sees it. Never carries a URL or a storage key.

NewPinRequest.description: A new pin (`pin.add`). Exactly one of `card_id` and `decoration`.

card_id.description: A card the caller may pin (see the operation description).

decoration.description: Registry reference `{id, version, params?}` of kind `decoration`.

x.description: Centre, as a fraction of the board width (0..=1).

y.description: Centre, as a fraction of the board height (0..=1).

z_key.description: Fractional index for z-order: 1..=32 of `[0-9A-Za-z]`, compared as bytes.

NotificationPreferences.description: Body of `PUT` and answer of both routes.

time_zone.description:
IANA time zone of the device (e.g. `Europe/Paris`). Quiet hours apply only once it is
known; `null` = not sent yet.

card_new.description: New cards from friends (single and batched).

OwnerInvitationView.description:
An invitation as the owner sees it: always `pending` until it is accepted, cancelled or
expires (declines and drops are not revealed).

PinLayoutView.description:
A pin's placement as the caller may see it in op results. Card contents are never part of an
op result: `card_id` is only echoed on pins the caller created; read the board to see cards.

mine.description: The caller created this pin (collaborators may move/remove only these).

oneOf.description: `conflict`: the pin as it is now (replace the local copy).

ops.description: 1..=50 ops with distinct `op_id`s, applied in order.

board_version.description: The board version after the batch (the delta-sync cursor).

results.description: One result per op, in request order.

PinSetRequest.description: The fields a `pin.update` changes (at least one), same ranges as [`NewPinRequest`].

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details with two extension members: `code` and `requestId`.

code.description: Stable error code clients can switch on.

detail.description: Safe, human-readable explanation. Never contains internal details.

requestId.description: Id of the failing request (same value as the `X-Request-Id` response header).

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type (`about:blank` = see `status` and `code`).

ProfileRequest.description: Body of `PUT /v1/me/profile`. The account is always the caller's; no id is accepted.

display_name.description: 2-30 characters (grapheme clusters) after sanitizing; not unique, never searchable.

ProfileResponse.description: Result of a profile write: the account status and onboarding step after it, and the profile.

ProfileView.description:
The caller's own profile. Display names are stored sanitized (what is returned is what
others will see).

cache_tag.description:
CDN cache tag the web server must put on the page and OG responses (`Cache-Tag`), so a
revoked or expired link is purged by tag (T-133).

cache_ttl_s.description: Seconds the web server may cache this page (purged on revoke, T-133).

noindex.description: Always `true`: public pages are not indexed (AC-24.5).

PublicBoardView.description: Board header of a public page.

backdrop.description: Registry reference of the backdrop, or `null` for the default.

PublicInviteResponse.description: What the invite landing page shows.

items.description: Live links (not revoked, not expired), newest first.

PublicLinkView.description: A public link as its owner sees it in lists (no token).

PublicOgResponse.description: A fresh signed URL of the watermarked OG image (the web server answers 302 to it).

PublicPinView.description:
One pin of a public page: `card` (the owner's own card, watermarked), `private_tile` (any
other card: position only) or `decoration`.

image_url.description: `card` only: signed URL of the watermarked image (10 minutes).

card_ids.description: Ids of the cards the app keeps offline (feed copy, widget, boards), 1..=100.

purge.description:
Cached cards to delete now (with any metadata or pictures kept for them). The ids are a
subset of the request; a card the caller may still see is never listed.

token.description: The provider token: APNs hex device token, or FCM registration token.

end.description: Local time `HH:MM` (24 h); may be earlier than `start` (overnight window).

items.description: Newest first; only people who are still my friends.

policy_config_version.description: Version of the loaded region policy config.

ReauthRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/auth/reauth`: a fresh provider proof for the signed-in account.

id_token.description: A fresh ID token from the provider's native sheet.

nonce.description:
The raw nonce of this proof (16 to 256 visible ASCII characters, single use), as for
sign-in.

ReauthResponse.description: A re-auth token: send it as `X-Reauth` (next to the normal bearer token) to `re` routes.

reauth_token.description: Opaque, single device session, 5 minutes. Never a bearer token.

ReceivedInvitationView.description: A pending invitation as its invitee sees it. No member list before accepting.

RefreshRequest.description:
Body of `POST /v1/auth/refresh`. Only the refresh token: the session (and therefore the
account) is derived from it, never from a client-supplied id.

hint.description:
Present only on incoming requests to a minor whose sender is an adult with no mutual
friends (AC-5.5). Never present for adult recipients.

handle.description:
The exact handle, case-insensitive, with or without a leading `@`. Partial input never
matches anything.

oneOf.description: `null` = "No one found": the same for a missing handle and for any hidden account.

ref.description:
Pass as `search_ref` to `POST /v1/friend-requests` within 10 minutes. Opaque, and only valid
for the account that searched.

recipient_count.description: How many current friends will receive it (who was dropped is never revealed).

SentRequestView.description: A request as its sender sees it: pending until accepted or expired.

status.description: Always `pending` for the sender (declines and blocks are silent).

SessionView.description: One signed-in device. No token material.

client_label.description: Platform and app version, e.g. `ios 1.2.0` (null when the device sent none).

ip_country.description: ISO country seen at sign-in, when known.

findable_by_handle.description: Let others find me by exact handle (adults only).

SettingsView.description: The caller's privacy settings, as they apply right now.

can_be_findable.description: Whether this account may turn `findable_by_handle` on (false under the discovery age).

findable_by_handle.description:
Whether others can find me by exact handle. Always `false` under the region's discovery
age (the toggle cannot be turned on then).

TextFilterHints.description:
The filter's settings as served to clients in `GET /v1/config` (#213): the sanitizer caps and
the term lists exactly as written in `config/text_filter.yaml`. For instant hints in the app
only; the server's own check stays authoritative. Public by design (EM decision 2026-11-05).

max_chars_per_grapheme.description: Grapheme clusters with more code points than this are dropped.

max_marks_per_grapheme.description: Combining marks kept per grapheme cluster (viramas exempt).

TokenPair.description: A new access + refresh token pair. Store both in the device's secure storage only.

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single use. Replaying a used one signs out the whole session.

backdrop.description: A backdrop reference, or `null` to reset to the default; omit to keep the current one.

base_version.description: The pin `version` the client last saw.

UserSummaryView.description: Another account as shown in request and friend lists.

deep_link.description: Opens the card in the app.

image_url.description: `widget_512` rendition signed for the viewer (10 min).

token.description:
Bearer token for `GET /v1/widget` only. Store it in the widget's OS-protected storage
(iOS app-group Keychain, Android EncryptedSharedPreferences); it dies with this session.

oneOf.description: `null` when there is nothing to show (no card, unfriended, blocked, deleted).
